title: The rundown
note: What's going on right now, in one place. The ↗ links out to the original source; the item's own text turns into a link only once it becomes a full entry here.

items.text: Bitcoin spiked above $86,000 ahead of Friday's September jobs report, then reversed toward $84,000 after the data came in far weaker than expected, with roughly $600 million in crypto positions liquidated in the swing.
Ethereum developers are targeting October 6 to activate the "Glamsterdam" upgrade on the Sepolia public testnet, trialing a 200-million gas limit ahead of a planned mainnet launch later this quarter.

Google has begun rolling out Gemini 4 Argon to a small group of cybersecurity partners, including Wiz, claiming it beats OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on several coding and knowledge benchmarks and pricing it at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.

Astronomers using the MeerKAT radio array detected the first radio emission ever traced directly to an exoplanet rather than its star: auroral bursts from Beta Pictoris b, a young gas giant 63 light-years away, implying a magnetic field over a thousand times stronger than Earth's.

The 2026 Nobel Prize announcements begin Monday, October 5 with Physiology or Medicine and run through Economic Sciences on October 12, with each prize now worth 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.21 million), up from 11 million, to mark the award's 125th anniversary.

NASA and SpaceX's Crew-13 docked at the space station's Harmony module on October 1, carrying NASA's Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, Canada's Josh Kutryk and Russia's Sergey Teteryatnikov into Expedition 75 for a roughly seven-month stay.

Three Russian missiles and two drones struck Moldovan territory on Saturday, setting off explosions, fires and property damage across several districts as the war next door increasingly spills into its neighbor.
Dakota Johnson hosts Saturday Night Live tonight for the third time, with hardcore band Turnstile making its SNL debut as musical guest.
